Building and bases

Set access rules for shared clan resources

If your server offers a clan warehouse, quarry and missions, check who can deposit and withdraw items. Agree on fuel supply, patrols and who may spend scarce materials before a large build or raid.

Quarry output still carries risk. The source’s exact reward, permission, claim-period and structure-limit claims have not been checked against the current version; use the in-game interface.
